name: Casting Pearls Before Swine
overview: The Scripture warns believers to exercise discernment in sharing holy truths, as illustrated in Matthew 7:6, which cautions against giving what is holy to those who will not value it, likening such actions to casting pearls before swine who will trample and harm. This teaching aligns with the call in Matthew 7:1 to avoid judgment that invites judgment upon oneself, emphasizing a balanced approach to engaging others. Revelation 22:11 further underscores the reality of persistent moral states, encouraging believers to recognize when righteousness and holiness are embraced or rejected, thus guiding prudent sharing of the gospel.
